mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN device_brand != '' AND os_name = 'ios' THEN 1 END) as iosAppCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_brand != '' AND os_name = 'android' THEN 1 END) as androidAppCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_brand = '' AND browser_name = 'WeChat' THEN 1 END) as wechatCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_brand = '' AND browser_name != 'WeChat' THEN 1 END) as browserCount FROM member_event_log WHERE event_code IN ('social_login', 'login') AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
SELECT id, user_id FROM member_event_log WHERE event_code IN ('social_login', 'login') AND user_id = #{userId} AND device_brand != '' AND (os_name = 'ios' OR os_name = 'android') limit 1
